name: Board task list
description:
**Summary of this conversation (5 lines)**

1. Created `TaskTableView.vue` — a dense, filterable task table (search, column/status/priority/due/profile/assignee/type, sortable headers, 50-row pagination) for kanban boards and sprints.
2. Added a **ProjectManager** quick-chat button to `KanbanBoardView` that creates a new chat already carrying that profile and opens it for editing.
3. Made the table available in sprints (Board · Table · Gantt selector next to board/gantt), moved the board filter into the extended filters and only when not in a Board/Sprint view, and added task filtering + a board filter to `KanbanList`.
4. Iterated on the row design: quick time filter (1h / Today / This week / Custom), **Last update** column from-now with exact timestamp, **Profiles**, **Project** (chat-level target with icon, owner when different), and a 200-char last-message excerpt with a higher-contrast sender avatar.
5. Reviewed `TaskTableView` after it was overwritten by another task and re-applied all those changes, then fixed the "missing columns" by un-gating them from `xl`/`md` breakpoints and surfacing the message-level project icon in `ChatEntry`.
